slot.brief: Two gases effuse through the same pinhole in the same time; set up the Graham's law ratio and find the unknown molar mass.

stem: Under the same conditions, gases $X$ and $Y$ effuse through the same pinhole in equal times in volume ratio $3:2$. If $M_Y = 36$ g mol$^{-1}$, find $M_X$.

verdicts.working: By Graham’s law, V_X/V_Y=√(M_Y/M_X). Thus 3/2=√(36/M_X), giving M_X=16 g mol⁻¹.

working:
$\dfrac{r_X}{r_Y}=\dfrac{3}{2}=\sqrt{\dfrac{M_Y}{M_X}}$ 
$M_X=36\left(\dfrac{2}{3}\right)^2=16\ \text{g mol}^{-1}$

Independent check: By Graham’s law, V_X/V_Y=√(M_Y/M_X). Thus 3/2=√(36/M_X), giving M_X=16 g mol⁻¹.
solution:
By Graham’s law, the volume ratio in equal times is $\dfrac{V_X}{V_Y}=\sqrt{\dfrac{M_Y}{M_X}}$.\\
$$\dfrac{3}{2}=\sqrt{\dfrac{36}{M_X}}\quad\Rightarrow\quad M_X=36\left(\dfrac{2}{3}\right)^2=16\ \text{g mol}^{-1}$$
